context.person: A person using an electronics retailer
context.journey_stage: Part of an order was canceled
context.user_goal: Choose another monitor separately if one is still needed.

product_state.preceding_state: One item in a three-item order was canceled after inventory verification.
product_state.current_state: The laptop and charger will ship tomorrow. The monitor was canceled.
known_facts: The laptop and charger will ship tomorrow.
The monitor charge was voided before settlement.
The promotional bundle discount remains on the shipped items.
forbidden_claims: A monitor refund was issued after a completed charge.

current_content.heading: You're all set!
current_content.body: We're working on it. Check again later.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product status card so the person can understand part of an order was canceled, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: View the two items that will ship.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The order continues without the monitor and no settled monitor charge exists.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Choose another monitor separately if one is still needed.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
